ayahs.2: Is kitaab ka naazil farmaana us Allah ki taraf se hai jo Ghaalib aur Daana hai.
ayahs.3: Gunaah ka bakhshne wala aur tauba ka qubool farmaane wala, sakht azaab wala, inaam-o-qudrat wala, jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin. Usi ki taraf wapas lautna hai.
ayahs.4: Allah Taala ki aayaton mein wohi log jhagadte hain jo kaafir hain, pas un logon ka shahron mein chalna phirna aap ko dhoke mein na daale.
ayahs.5: Qaum-e-Nooh ne aur un ke baad ke girohon ne bhi jhutlaaya tha. Aur har ummat ne apne Rasool ko giraftar kar lene ka iraada kiya aur baatil ke zariye kaj-bahsiyaan kin, taake un se haq ko bigaad den, pas main ne un ko pakad liya, so meri taraf se kaisi saza hui.
ayahs.6: Aur isi tarah aap ke Rabb ka hukm kaafiron par saabit ho gaya ke woh dozakhii hain.
ayahs.7: Arsh ke uthaane wale aur us ke aas paas ke (farishte) apne Rabb ki tasbeeh hamd ke saath saath karte hain aur us par imaan rakhte hain aur imaan walon ke liye istighfar karte hain, kehte hain ke ae hamare Parwardigaar! Tu ne har cheez ko apni bakhshish aur ilm se gher rakha hai, pas tu unhein bakhsh de jo tauba karen aur teri raah ki pairawi karen aur tu unhein dozakh ke azaab se bhi bacha le.
ayahs.8: Ae hamare Rabb! Tu unhein hameshgi wali jannaton mein le ja jin ka tu ne un se waada kiya hai aur un ke baap daadon aur biwiyon aur aulaad mein se (bhi) un (sab) ko jo nek amal hain. Yaqeenan tu to Ghaalib-o-Ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.9: Unhein buraiyon se bhi mehfooz rakh, haq to yeh hai ke us din tu ne jise buraiyon se bacha liya us par tu ne rehmat kar di aur bahut badi kaamyaabi to yehi hai.
ayahs.10: Be-shak jin logon ne kufr kiya unhein yeh awaaz di jaayegi ke yaqeenan Allah ka tum par ghussa hona is se bahut zyada hai jo tum ghussa hote the apne ji se, jab tum imaan ki taraf bulaaye jaate the phir kufr karne lagte the.
ayahs.11: Woh kahenge ae hamare Parwardigaar! Tu ne hamein do baar maara aur do baar hi jilaaya, ab hum apne gunaahon ke iqraari hain, to kya ab koi raah nikalne ki bhi hai?
ayahs.12: Yeh (azaab) tumhein is liye hai ke jab sirf akele Allah ka zikr kiya jaata to tum inkaar kar jaate the aur agar us ke saath kisi ko shareek kiya jaata tha to tum maan lete the, pas ab faisla Allah Buland-o-Buzurg hi ka hai.
ayahs.13: Wohi hai jo tumhein apni nishaniyan dikhlaata hai aur tumhare liye aasman se rozi utaarta hai, naseehat to sirf wohi haasil karte hain jo (Allah ki taraf) ruju karte hain.
ayahs.14: Tum Allah ko pukaarte raho us ke liye deen ko khaalis kar ke go kaafir bura maanein.
ayahs.15: Buland darjon wala, arsh ka maalik, woh apne bandon mein se jis par chahta hai wahi naazil farmaata hai, taake woh mulaqaat ke din se daraaye.
ayahs.16: Jis din sab log zaahir ho jaayenge, un ki koi cheez Allah se posheeda na rahegi. Aaj kis ki baadshahi hai? Faqat Allah Waahid-o-Qahhaar ki.
ayahs.17: Aaj har nafs ko us ki kamaai ka badla diya jaayega. Aaj (kisi qism ka) zulm nahin, yaqeenan Allah Taala bahut jald hisaab karne wala hai.
ayahs.18: Aur unhein bahut hi qareeb aane wali (qayamat se) aagaah kar dijiye, jabke dil halaq tak pahunch jaayenge aur sab khaamosh honge, zaalimon ka na koi dili dost hoga na sifarshi, ke jis ki baat maani jaayegi.
ayahs.19: Woh aankhon ki khayanat ko aur seenon ki posheeda baaton ko (khoob) jaanta hai.
ayahs.20: Aur Allah Taala theek theek faisla kar dega, us ke siwa jinhein yeh log pukaarte hain woh kisi cheez ka bhi faisla nahin kar sakte, be-shak Allah Taala khoob sunta, khoob dekhta hai.
ayahs.21: Kya yeh log zameen mein chale phire nahin ke dekhte ke jo log un se pehle the un ka nateeja kaisa kuchh hua? Woh ba-itibaar-e-quwwat-o-taaqat ke aur ba-itibaar-e-zameen mein apni yaadgaron ke un se bahut zyada the, pas Allah ne unhein un ke gunaahon par pakad liya aur koi na hua jo unhein Allah ke azaab se bacha leta.
ayahs.22: Yeh is wajah se ke un ke paas un ke Paighambar mojize le le kar aate the to woh inkaar kar dete the, pas Allah unhein pakad leta tha. Yaqeenan woh taaqatwar aur sakht azaab wala hai.
ayahs.23: Aur hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko apni aayaton aur khuli daleelon ke saath bheja.
ayahs.24: Firaun, Haamaan aur Qaroon ki taraf, to unhon ne kaha (yeh to) jaadugar aur jhootha hai.
ayahs.25: Pas jab un ke paas (Moosa alaihis salaam) hamari taraf se (deen) haq ko le kar aaye to unhon ne kaha ke is ke saath jo imaan wale hain un ke ladkon ko to maar daalo aur un ki ladkiyon ko zinda rakho aur kaafiron ki jo heela-saazi hai woh ghalati mein hi hai.
ayahs.26: Aur Firaun ne kaha mujhe chhod do ke main Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko maar daaloon aur use chahiye ke apne Rabb ko pukaare, mujhe to dar hai ke yeh kahin tumhara deen na badal daale ya mulk mein koi (bahut bada) fasaad barpa na kar de.
ayahs.27: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha main apne aur tumhare Rabb ki panaah mein aata hoon har us takabbur karne wale shakhs (ki burai) se jo roz-e-hisaab par imaan nahin rakhta.
ayahs.28: Aur ek momin shakhs ne, jo Firaun ke khandaan mein se tha aur apna imaan chhupaaye hue tha, kaha ke kya tum ek shakhs ko mehaz is baat par qatl karte ho ke woh kehta hai mera Rabb Allah hai aur tumhare Rabb ki taraf se daleelein le kar aaya hai, agar woh jhootha ho to us ka jhoot usi par hai aur agar woh sachcha ho, to jis (azaab) ka woh tum se waada kar raha hai us mein se kuchh na kuchh to tum par aa padega, Allah Taala us ki rehberi nahin karta jo hadd se guzar jaane wale aur jhoothe hain.
ayahs.29: Ae meri qaum ke logo! Aaj to baadshahat tumhari hai ke is zameen par tum ghaalib ho lekin agar Allah ka azaab hum par aa gaya to kaun hamari madad karega? Firaun bola, main to tumhein wohi raaye de raha hoon jo khud dekh raha hoon aur main to tumhein bhalai ki raah hi batla raha hoon.
ayahs.30: Us momin ne kaha ae meri qaum! (ke logo) mujhe to andesha hai ke tum par bhi waisa hi roz (bad azaab) na aaye jo aur ummaton par aaya.
ayahs.31: Jaise ummat-e-Nooh aur Aad-o-Samood aur un ke baad walon ka (haal hua), Allah apne bandon par kisi tarah ka zulm karna nahin chahta.
ayahs.32: Aur mujhe tum par haank-pukaar ke din ka bhi dar hai.
ayahs.33: Jis din tum peeth pher kar lautoge, tumhein Allah se bachaane wala koi na hoga aur jise Allah gumraah kar de us ka haadi koi nahin.
ayahs.34: Aur is se pehle tumhare paas (Hazrat) Yusuf daleelein le kar aaye, phir bhi tum un ki laai hui (daleel) mein shak-o-shubha hi karte rahe, yahan tak ke jab un ki wafaat ho gayi to kehne lage un ke baad to Allah kisi Rasool ko bhejega hi nahin, isi tarah Allah gumraah karta hai har us shakhs ko jo hadd se badh jaane wala, shak-o-shubha karne wala ho.
ayahs.35: Jo baghair kisi sanad ke jo un ke paas aayi ho Allah ki aayaton mein jhagadte hain, Allah ke nazdeek aur mominon ke nazdeek yeh to bahut badi naraazgi ki cheez hai, Allah Taala isi tarah har ek maghroor sarkash ke dil par mohar kar deta hai.
ayahs.36: Firaun ne kaha ae Haamaan! Mere liye ek baala-khana bana, shayad ke main aasman ke jo darwaaze hain.
ayahs.37: (Un) darwaazon tak pahunch jaaun aur Moosa ke mabood ko jhaank loon aur be-shak main samajhta hoon woh jhootha hai aur isi tarah Firaun ki bad-kardariyan use bhali dikhai gayin aur raah se rok diya gaya aur Firaun ki (har) heela-saazi tabaahi mein hi rahi.
ayahs.38: Aur us momin shakhs ne kaha ke ae meri qaum! (ke logo) tum (sab) meri pairawi karo, main nek raah ki taraf tumhari rehberi karoonga.
ayahs.39: Ae meri qaum! Yeh hayaat-e-dunya mataa-e-faani hai, (yaqeen maano ke qaraar) aur hameshgi ka ghar to aakhirat hi hai.
ayahs.40: Jis ne gunaah kiya hai use to baraabar baraabar ka badla hi hai aur jis ne neki ki hai, khwah woh mard ho ya aurat aur woh imaan wala ho, to yeh log jannat mein jaayenge aur wahan be-shumaar rozi paayenge.
ayahs.41: Ae meri qaum! Yeh kya baat hai ke main tumhein najat ki taraf bula raha hoon aur tum mujhe dozakh ki taraf bula rahe ho.
ayahs.42: Tum mujhe yeh daawat de rahe ho ke main Allah ke saath kufr karoon aur us ke saath shirk karoon jis ka koi ilm mujhe nahin aur main tumhein Ghaalib Bakhshne wale (mabood) ki taraf daawat de raha hoon.
ayahs.43: Yeh yaqini amar hai ke tum mujhe jis ki taraf bula rahe ho woh to na dunya mein pukaare jaane ke qaabil hai na aakhirat mein, aur yeh (bhi yaqini baat hai) ke hum sab ka lautna Allah ki taraf hai aur hadd se guzar jaane wale hi (yaqeenan) ahl-e-dozakh hain.
ayahs.44: Pas aage chal kar tum meri baaton ko yaad karoge, main apna maamla Allah ke supurd karta hoon, yaqeenan Allah Taala bandon ka nigehbaan hai.
ayahs.45: Pas use Allah Taala ne tamaam badiyon se mehfooz rakh liya jo unhon ne soch rakhi thin aur Firaun walon par buri tarah ka azaab ulat pada.
ayahs.46: Aag hai jis ke saamne yeh har subah shaam laaye jaate hain aur jis din qayamat qaayam hogi (farmaan hoga ke) Firauniyon ko sakht-tareen azaab mein daalo.
ayahs.47: Aur jabke dozakh mein ek doosre se jhagadenge to kamzor log takabbur walon se (jin ke yeh taabe the) kahenge ke hum to tumhare pairo the, to kya ab tum hum se is aag ka koi hissa hata sakte ho?
ayahs.48: Woh bade log jawab denge hum to sabhi is aag mein hain, Allah Taala apne bandon ke darmiyaan faisle kar chuka hai.
ayahs.49: Aur (tamaam) jahannami mil kar jahannam ke daroghon se kahenge ke tum hi apne Parwardigaar se dua karo ke woh kisi din to hamare azaab mein kami kar de.
ayahs.50: Woh jawab denge ke kya tumhare paas tumhare Rasool mojize le kar nahin aaye the? Woh kahenge kyun nahin, woh kahenge ke phir tum hi dua karo aur kaafiron ki dua mehaz be-asar aur be-raah hai.
ayahs.51: Yaqeenan hum apne Rasoolon ki aur imaan walon ki madad zindagaani-e-dunya mein bhi karenge aur us din bhi jab gawahi dene wale khade honge.
ayahs.52: Jis din zaalimon ko un ki (uzr) maazrat kuchh nafa na degi, un ke liye laanat hi hogi aur un ke liye bura ghar hoga.
ayahs.53: Hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko hidayat-naama ata farmaaya aur Bani Israel ko is kitaab ka waaris banaaya.
ayahs.54: Ke woh hidayat-o-naseehat thi aqalmandon ke liye.
ayahs.55: Pas ae Nabi! Tu sabr kar, Allah ka waada bila-shak (o-shubha) sachcha hi hai, tu apne gunaah ki maafi maangta reh aur subah shaam apne Parwardigaar ki tasbeeh aur hamd bayaan karta reh.
ayahs.56: Jo log bawajood apne paas kisi sanad ke na hone ke aayat-e-Ilahi mein jhagda karte hain un ke dilon mein bajuz niri badaai ke aur kuchh nahin, woh us tak pahunchne wale hi nahin, so tu Allah ki panaah maangta reh, be-shak woh poora sunne wala aur sab se zyada dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.57: Aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish yaqeenan insaan ki paidaish se bahut bada kaam hai, lekin (yeh aur baat hai ke) aksar log be-ilm hain.
ayahs.58: Andha aur beena baraabar nahin, na woh log jo imaan laaye aur bhale kaam kiye badkaron ke (baraabar hain), tum (bahut) kam naseehat haasil kar rahe ho.
ayahs.59: Qayamat bil-yaqeen aur be-shubha aane wali hai, lekin (yeh aur baat hai ke) bahut se log imaan nahin laate.
ayahs.60: Aur tumhare Rabb ka farmaan (sarzad ho chuka hai) ke mujh se dua karo main tumhari duaon ko qubool karoonga, yaqeen maano ke jo log meri ibaadat se khud-sari karte hain woh anqareeb zaleel ho kar jahannam mein pahunch jaayenge.
ayahs.61: Allah Taala ne tumhare liye raat bana di ke tum is mein aaraam haasil karo aur din ko dekhne wala bana diya, be-shak Allah Taala logon par fazl-o-karam wala hai lekin aksar log shukr-guzari nahin karte.
ayahs.62: Yehi Allah hai tum sab ka Rabb, har cheez ka khaaliq, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, phir kahan tum phire jaate ho.
ayahs.63: Isi tarah woh log bhi phere jaate rahe jo Allah ki aayaton ka inkaar karte the.
ayahs.64: Allah hi hai jis ne tumhare liye zameen ko thaharne ki jagah aur aasman ko chhat bana diya aur tumhari sooratein banaayen aur bahut achchhi banaayen aur tumhein umda umda cheezein khaane ko ata farmaayen, yehi Allah tumhara Parwardigaar hai, pas bahut hi barkaton wala Allah hai saare jahaan ka parwarish karne wala.
ayahs.65: Woh zinda hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin, pas tum khaalis us ki ibaadat karte hue use pukaaro, tamaam khoobiyan Allah hi ke liye hain jo tamaam jahaanon ka Rabb hai.
ayahs.66: Aap keh dijiye! Ke mujhe un ki ibaadat se rok diya gaya hai jinhein tum Allah ke siwa pukaar rahe ho, is bina par ke mere paas mere Rabb ki daleelein pahunch chuki hain, mujhe yeh hukm diya gaya hai ke main tamaam jahaanon ke Rabb ka taabe-farmaan ho jaaun.
ayahs.67: Woh wohi hai jis ne tumhein mitti se phir nutfe se phir khoon ke lothde se paida kiya, phir tumhein bachcha ki soorat mein nikaalta hai, phir (tumhein badhaata hai ke) tum apni poori quwwat ko pahunch jaao, phir boodhe ho jaao, tum mein se baaz is se pehle hi faut ho jaate hain, (woh tumhein chhod deta hai) taake tum muddat-e-muayyan tak pahunch jaao aur taake tum soch samajh lo.
ayahs.68: Wohi hai jo jilaata hai aur maar daalta hai, phir jab woh kisi kaam ka karna muqarrar karta hai to use sirf yeh kehta hai ke ho ja, pas woh ho jaata hai.
ayahs.69: Kya tu ne unhein dekha jo Allah ki aayaton mein jhagadte hain, woh kahan pher diye jaate hain.
ayahs.70: Jin logon ne kitaab ko jhutlaaya aur use bhi jo hum ne apne Rasoolon ke saath bheja, unhein abhi abhi haqeeqat-e-haal maaloom ho jaayegi.
ayahs.71: Jabke un ki gardanon mein tauq honge aur zanjeerein hongi, ghaseete jaayenge.
ayahs.72: Khaulte hue paani mein aur phir jahannam ki aag mein jalaaye jaayenge.
ayahs.73: Phir un se poochha jaayega ke jinhein tum shareek karte the woh kahan hain.
ayahs.74: Jo Allah ke siwa the, woh kahenge ke woh to hum se behak gaye, balke hum to is se pehle kisi ko bhi pukaarte hi na the. Allah Taala kaafiron ko isi tarah gumraah karta hai.
ayahs.75: Yeh badla hai us cheez ka jo tum zameen mein na-haq phoole na samaate the. Aur (beja) itraate phirte the.
ayahs.76: (Ab aao) jahannam mein hamesha rehne ke liye (is ke) darwaazon mein daakhil ho jaao, kya hi buri jagah hai takabbur karne wale ki.
ayahs.77: Pas aap sabr karen, Allah ka waada qatan sachcha hai, unhein hum ne jo waade de rakhe hain un mein se kuchh hum aap ko dikhayen ya (is se pehle) hum aap ko wafaat de dein, un ka lautaya jaana to hamari hi taraf hai.
ayahs.78: Yaqeenan hum aap se pehle bhi bahut se Rasool bhej chuke hain jin mein se baaz ke (waqiat) hum aap ko bayaan kar chuke hain aur un mein se baaz ke (qisse) to hum ne aap ko bayaan hi nahin kiye aur kisi Rasool ka yeh (maqdoor) na tha ke koi mojiza Allah ki ijaazat ke baghair la sake, phir jis waqt Allah ka hukm aayega haq ke saath faisla kar diya jaayega aur is jagah ahl-e-baatil khasaare mein reh jaayenge.
ayahs.79: Allah woh hai jis ne tumhare liye chaupaaye paida kiye jin mein se baaz par tum sawaar hote ho aur baaz ko tum khaate ho.
ayahs.80: Aur bhi tumhare liye un mein bahut se nafa hain aur taake apne seenon mein chhupi hui haajaton ko inhi par sawaari kar ke tum haasil kar lo aur un chaupaiyon par aur kashtiyon par sawaar kiye jaate ho.
ayahs.81: Allah tumhein apni nishaniyan dikhata ja raha hai, pas tum Allah ki kin kin nishaniyon ke munkir bante rahoge.
ayahs.82: Kya unhon ne zameen mein chal phir kar apne se pehlon ka anjaam nahin dekha? Jo un se taadaad mein zyada the, quwwat mein sakht aur zameen mein bahut saari yaadgarein chhodi thin, un ke kiye kaamon ne unhein kuchh bhi faida nahin pahunchaaya.
ayahs.83: Pas jab bhi un ke paas un ke Rasool khuli nishaniyan le kar aaye to yeh apne paas ke ilm par itraane lage, bil-aakhir jis cheez ko mazaaq mein uda rahe the woh un par ulat padi.
ayahs.84: Hamara azaab dekhte hi kehne lage ke Allah Waahid par hum imaan laaye aur jin jin ko hum us ka shareek bana rahe the hum ne un sab se inkaar kiya.
ayahs.85: Lekin hamare azaab ko dekh lene ke baad un ke imaan ne unhein nafa na diya. Allah ne apna mamool yehi muqarrar kar rakha hai jo us ke bandon mein baraabar chala aa raha hai. Aur is jagah kaafir kharaab-o-khasta hue.
